checkTicketFreshness.display_name: Check knowledge freshness for a resolved ticket
checkTicketFreshness.description: Call when a ticket is resolved. Finds the solution article behind the resolution and reports whether it is fresh, drifting, or missing (knowledge gap).

ticket_id.description: ID of the resolved Freshdesk ticket, e.g. 1042

freshness.description: fresh, emerging_drift, high_drift, knowledge_gap or not_checked

is_stale.description: True when the article no longer matches how agents resolve this

summary.description: One-paragraph explanation for the agent or admin

agent_path.description: Path the resolving agent actually used

followed_article.description: True when this ticket followed the documented path

changed_step.description: The step that drifted, e.g. Billing -> Payments

drift_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence that the article is outdated

evidence.description: How many agents and tickets confirm the drift

bot_message.description: Safe customer-facing wording for this procedure

alert_id.description: KnowledgeOps alert awaiting review, if any

admin_notified.description: True when the admin was phoned about this drift

getArticleFreshness.description: Check whether a solution article is still accurate or has open knowledge-drift alerts. Read-only and fast.

article_id.description: ID of the Freshdesk solution article

is_stale.description: True when the article is outdated

drift_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence that the article is outdated

bot_message.description: Safe customer-facing wording for this procedure
